Love Nov 1 2026 6:10 PM PT: "gold can keep the $10 level , the 55% from pink to green and pink to red is there. last rung and last channel stay for gold. btc no longs over +2o stays as well. 1. Session band: A. If pink sits inside an unbroken session band's tolerance, no short is allowed at that pink break until the session band itself breaks by its own tolerance. Longs under an unbroken session band mirror the same rule. This applies to both gold and BTC. 2. Pink: B, with gold's break set to 25 cents. A short is refused only while price is still inside the pink cushion. Once price is outside the cushion, the pink check returns free. Gold's required break of pink is 25 cents. BTC's required break of pink remains $5. Longs under an unbroken pink mirror the same rule on both assets. 3. Entry logic: A. Remove every gold-only and BTC-only rule that is not a tolerance. The only remaining differences between gold and BTC are the pink tolerance and the session-band tolerance. and the special instances i named aside earlier in this message. Entry on both assets is a 2-5m candle that has flipped her colour and is pushing away from a band. No other entry condition differs between the two assets. $5 push in our favor for btc, 10c push for gold."
+ 7:10 PM PT: "it cannot block a trade with a band under pink at any distance. only if pink is in the bottom or top 20% of the channel stacked on top of a session band. only then it has to wait for the band to break. if price breaks pink and price is still in the top or bottom 33% of the channel after that she still cannot short or long into an unbroken band. it has to break the band or trade the rejection away from it."
+ 7:45 PM PT: "implement the same sliding scale for pinks stacked on top of each other. 33% at $10 and under and 20% over $20. PLEASE CALCULATE IT FROM SESSION BAND TO SESSION BAND AND INCORPORATE THE SAME SLIDING SCALE FOR PINK TOLERANCES STACKED ON TOP OF EACH OTHER AT DIFFERENT BAND WIDTHS."
+ 7:50 PM PT: "Channel percentage is calculated from session band to session band. Stacked pink tolerance: Channel $10 and under: 33%. Channel over $20: 20%. Between $10 and $20: linear slide from 33% to 20%. Add a distance check that refuses a short when an unbroken pink sits inside the session-band tolerance directly under the entry, and refuses a long when an unbroken pink sits inside the session-band tolerance directly above the entry. This check runs on both gold and BTC. It does not replace the percentage rule. It sits in front of it."
what: fix618 pinkClose618: unbroken pink inside the session-band tolerance directly under a short or over a long refuses it, both assets, in front of the percentage rule. pinkAhead618: pink inside her session-band scale of an unbroken session band, no trade through it until the band breaks, both assets, mirrored. Gold gets the same carried logic as BTC until her $5. One-asset entry conditions off: gold tight bands, $3 zone clearance, 30c candle, fresh out of fake-outs, zones as walls, line within $1 of the strike; BTC Bollinger within $100 of the pink, headroom. Pink re-aims on both. Kept: gold $10 level, 55%, last rung, last channel, BTC +2 sigma and -2 sigma rungs, and their tolerances.
books: main, rejection and every book but delayed. 5M untouched and off.
